scenes.description: Big headline with the style's signature text animation (mask/words/chars/slam/scramble/blur), optional eyebrow pill and subtitle. The workhorse hook/section title.

title.description: Headline. Use \n for a deliberate line break. ≤ 8 words lands best.

accent.description: Exact substring of title to color in the brand primary.

exit.description: Animate text out before the cut.

scenes.description: Rapid hard-cut word flashes on the beat (strobing ink/background), landing on a held final line. High-energy hooks and lists.

words.description: Short words/phrases hard-cut one after another (on the beat).

final.description: Held last line after the flashes.

invertEvery.description: Alternate background/ink on each flash for strobe energy.

scenes.description: 1-4 lines rising from masks in sequence, earlier lines dimming — an argument building line by line. Great for problem→solution.

lines.description: Lines revealed in sequence; earlier lines dim as new ones land.

scenes.description: Title + 2-6 items punching in with check/arrow/number markers, one optionally emphasized. Features, steps, benefits.

emphasis.description: 0-based item index to highlight in brand color.

scenes.description: Testimonial: big quote mark, quote words fade in, author + role (+ avatar) below.

example.quote: We cut our launch video time from a week to an afternoon.
example.author: Alex Rivera

scenes.description: The brand's REAL website/product screenshot in a browser window: 3D tilt-up entrance, slow scroll, optional push-in on a point (zoom), cursor click, and callout labels. Optional title switches to text-left layout. Use whenever real screenshots exist — real UI beats invented UI.

screenshot.description: Asset path to a real screenshot of the site/product (full-page screenshots scroll).

title.description: Optional caption; switches to a two-column layout with text left.

scroll.description: Fraction of the page to scroll through during the scene.

zoom.description: Push in on a point of the visible viewport (x,y fractions) — e.g. the main CTA button.

duration.description: Seconds the push-in takes — raise it to slow the zoom (0.7x speed = duration / 0.7).

click.description: Cursor flies in and clicks at x,y (viewport fractions).

callouts.description: Labels that pop next to points on the viewport.

scenes.description: Built app mock (sidebar, heading, big primary button) — cursor flies in, clicks, spinner → check, success toast pops. Optional particle assembly intro. Use for the 'one click and it's done' moment when no screenshot exists.

heading.description: Heading inside the app UI (what the user is doing).

button.description: Primary button label that gets clicked.

particles.description: Window assembles from particles first (dev-tool vibe).

clickAt.description: Fraction of the scene when the click lands.

example.heading: Turn this flow into a video

scenes.description: 2-6 feature cards (lucide icon, title, short desc) rise in a staggered grid; optional card spotlight at the end.

highlight.description: 0-based card to spotlight at the end.

scenes.description: Prompt/search bar types a query, shimmering status line, then result cards drop in. AI search, agents, 'ask anything' products.

query.description: Typed into the search/prompt bar (≤ 50 chars).

status.description: Shimmering status line after enter, e.g. 'Searching the web…'

example.query: What changed in our signup flow?

scenes.description: Chat thread: user bubbles, agent typing indicator then reply, then result cards slide up. Optional phone frame and caption column.

results.description: Task-result cards that slide up after the agent replies.

caption.description: Lines typed on the left (two-column layout).

messages.text: Make a 30s launch clip of onboarding

scenes.description: Notification cards stack in with a nervous jitter, then swipe away together ('problem → solved'). Optional phone lock screen + caption column.

logo.description: The app's real logo (resolved by the director) — shown instead of the icon.

mode.description: color = full-color mark on a light tile; glyph = one-color glyph on its brand-color tile

peel.description: Swipe them all away at the end (the 'problem solved' beat).

variant.description: cards = stacked cards · scatter = toasts pile up everywhere, camera pulls back · thread = a team channel scrolling · ticker = one message at a time, full-frame · lockscreen = phone with a big clock

scenes.description: Checkout/permission card with line items + total, floating brand badge 'waiting for approval', cursor clicks Approve → turns green. Agentic 'you stay in control' beat.
Phone rises in beside a caption column; shows a real app screenshot scrolling (or a branded splash). Mobile products.

screenshot.description: Asset path to an app screenshot (tall images scroll). Omit for a branded splash.

scenes.description: Real footage in a floating window that springs up to size (camera pushes through), optional browser chrome, optional ending mosaic of stills.

src.description: Asset path to real footage (screen recording, product clip).

startFrom.description: Seconds into the clip to start.

mosaic.description: Still images for an ending mosaic wall (optional).

scenes.description: Terminal window (or full-bleed) typing commands with a blinking block caret; '>'-prefixed lines print as output (green if success). Optional brand-color flash out. CLIs, SDKs, deploys.

lines.description: Commands to type. Prefix a line with '>' to print it instantly as output (e.g. '> ✓ Deployed in 1.2s').

flash.description: Flash to brand color at the end (hard-cut driver).

window.description: Framed window vs. full-bleed black screen.

scenes.description: Syntax-highlighted editor; camera drifts in on one highlighted line while others dim; optional snippet that explodes full-screen at the end. Show the 3 lines of code it takes.

blowup.description: Short snippet that explodes to full-screen at the end (fake-3D zoom).

typing.description: Type the code in instead of showing it.

scenes.description: 1-3 huge numbers counting up to their targets (keeps $/%/x/commas formatting) with labels. Proof points. Looks great with tone 'primary'.
Ring fills while the percentage jumps in kinetic steps, then snaps to a check + 'Done'. Processing / rendering / deploying beats.

stepped.description: Percent jumps in kinetic steps instead of counting smoothly.

scenes.description: Animated bar chart (horizontal or vertical) with one highlighted bar — benchmarks, us vs. them.
Split screen: old way (slow list that glitches/strikes away) vs. new way (fast checked list in brand color).

collapseLeft.description: Old way glitches away near the end.

scenes.description: 2-5 nodes connected by lines that draw on (GSAP DrawSVG) with a glowing pulse travelling the chain. How-it-works / architecture.

highlight.description: 0-based node drawn in brand color (usually the product).

scenes.description: Cards burst out from center one by one with a camera flash and settle scattered around the frame — 'captures', 'moments', 'everything it grabbed'.

title.description: Centered text the cards burst out from.

scenes.description: Scattered cards slam onto an editing timeline; a playhead sweeps and auto-edit tags pop as it crosses. 'It edits itself.' Pairs with card_scatter.

clips.description: Clip labels (reuse the preceding card_scatter labels for continuity).

tags.description: Auto-edit tags that pop as the playhead crosses.

scenes.description: Social proof: 1-3 rows of customer logos/wordmarks drifting in opposite directions under a 'Trusted by' line.

logos.description: Company names (rendered as wordmarks) or asset paths to logo images.

scenes.description: Brand lockup reveal choreographed in GSAP (cross→mark, scale-blur pop, or bar wipe) using the real logo if available, then the tagline. Openers and closers.

variant.description: cross: lines draw a cross that resolves into the mark; scale: mark pops; wipe: logo wipes on behind a bar.

scenes.description: Closing card: logo, final headline, CTA button with a light sweep, URL, then fade out. Always the last scene.

example.headline: Ship the video with the feature.

scenes.description: A RAW Clep product capture in a floating browser window over the backdrop. The camera follows the trace.json focus points automatically — pushes in on each action, pans between them, pulls back at the end — with click ripples and label callouts. The Floating-window launch look.

src.description: RAW product capture (Clep recording) — not an already-zoomed edit.

focuses.description: From Clep trace.json → the camera follows these.

label.description: Callout pill shown at this point.

zoom.description: Default push-in on each focus (1 = no zoom).

width.description: Window width as a fraction of the frame at zoom 1.

scenes.description: An agent working through a list: table rows appear one by one, cells type in over shimmering placeholders, status goes working → done, with a live 'N / M done' counter. Agents, enrichment, batch jobs.

rows.description: Cell values per row (same length as columns).

status.description: Final status per row (default all done).

example.title: It works the list for you

scenes.description: Carousel of finished videos gliding past (Replit style): each settles at center full size and playing, neighbours smaller and dimmer. Use to show many outputs — 'every brand gets its own film'.

films.description: Finished videos (asset paths) that slide past, each playing.

caption.description: One line under the reel, ≤ 44 chars.

scenes.description: The product doing the work, filmed like a founder launch: the user's request types into an input bar, then the agent's findings stream in one per line in big type (value + ▲/▼ in the accent), the camera following each new line, older lines dimming. Optionally everything collapses into one huge payoff line. Use for AI agents, analytics, research, automation — any 'ask → it investigates → answer' story.

prompt.description: What the user types, lowercase and plain, ≤ 80 chars.

text.description: What the agent found, ≤ 48 chars: 'Amazon fees'

logo.description: Logo of the tool this finding came from (Shopify, Amazon…).

mode.description: color = full-color mark on a light tile; glyph = one-color glyph on its brand-color tile

steps.description: The investigation, one finding per step.

result.description: The payoff the steps collapse into, ≤ 40 chars: 'Profit −19%. $12,430.'

resultAccent.description: Exact substring of result to color.

status.description: Working label under the prompt, ≤ 32 chars. Defaults to 'Investigating'.

variant.description: rows = input bar + streaming rows · terminal = mono log · sheet = spreadsheet filling, camera pushes in · nodes = source logos wired to the agent · document = memo writing itself · cards = one big finding card at a time

example.prompt: why did churn go up in march?

clean-saas.label: Clean SaaS launch
clean-saas.description: Bright, precise, product-first. Subtle grid, soft shadows, real UI in focus. Smooth push-ins, blur/fade transitions, expo easing, word-by-word mask reveals.

dark-keynote.label: Dark keynote
dark-keynote.description: Apple-event cinematic. Near-black with a soft spotlight, huge tight type, slow elegant camera drifts, long blur dissolves, generous holds.

kinetic-bold.label: Kinetic bold
kinetic-bold.description: High-energy social cut. Hard cuts and whip pans on the beat, slammed uppercase type, rapid word flashes, punch-in zooms, flat high-contrast color blocks.

editorial-paper.label: Editorial paper
editorial-paper.description: Magazine / whiteboard explainer. Warm paper grain, big serif display type, ink-black and one rust accent, hard cuts, minimal camera.

neon-tech.label: Neon dev-tool
neon-tech.description: Dark terminal aesthetic for dev tools and AI infra. Dot grid, glowing accent, mono labels, scramble text, whip transitions, code and terminal scenes.

soft-brand.label: Soft consumer brand
soft-brand.description: Friendly consumer-app look. Airy gradient with blurred blobs, rounded cards, springy pop-ins, gray chat/notification bubbles, gentle zooms.

story-film.label: Story film
story-film.description: Founder-launch film. Flat brand-colored ground, no gradients or blobs. Text is the narrator: big type, words arriving one at a time, accent words underlined by a hand-drawn stroke. The product works in long, slowly pushing shots. Hard cuts and pushes, no dissolves.

anime.label: Anime
anime.description: Anime opening / manga panel energy. Speed-line backdrops, impact-frame cuts, slammed outlined type with hard offset shadows, halftone print texture, sparkles, punch-ins with shake.
